title: Quick Bitter Peruvian Peaches Arroz Con Pato
description: A light and refreshing Peruvian dish featuring peaches and a bitter twist, made with a mother sauce base and Whole30 friendly ingredients. This arroz con pato is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the duck breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the duck breast until browned on both sides.
Transfer the duck breast to the oven and roast for 15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the duck is cooking, heat the mother sauce in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced peaches and bitter melon to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the cauliflower rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the sauce and fruit.
Slice the cooked duck breast and serve on top of the arroz con pato.
